versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֧סֶף אַבְרָהָ֛ם וַיִּקַּ֥ח אִשָּׁ֖ה וּשְׁמָ֥הּ קְטוּרָֽה׃

controles.web: Abraham took another wife, and her name was Keturah.
controles.kjv: Then again Abraham took a wife, and her name was Keturah.
controles.livre: E Abraão tomou outra mulher, cujo nome foi Quetura;

versos.hebraico: וַתֵּ֣לֶד ל֗וֹ אֶת־זִמְרָן֙ וְאֶת־יָקְשָׁ֔ן וְאֶת־מְדָ֖ן וְאֶת־מִדְיָ֑ן וְאֶת־יִשְׁבָּ֖ק וְאֶת־שֽׁוּחַ׃

controles.web: She bore him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.
controles.kjv: And she bare him Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah.
controles.livre: A qual lhe deu à luz a Zinrã, e a Jocsã, e a Medã, e a Midiã, e a Jisbaque, e a Suá.

versos.hebraico: וְיָקְשָׁ֣ן יָלַ֔ד אֶת־שְׁבָ֖א וְאֶת־דְּדָ֑ן וּבְנֵ֣י דְדָ֔ן הָי֛וּ אַשּׁוּרִ֥ם וּלְטוּשִׁ֖ים וּלְאֻמִּֽים׃

controles.web: Jokshan became the father of Sheba, and Dedan. The sons of Dedan were Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim.
controles.kjv: And Jokshan begat Sheba, and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim, and Letushim, and Leummim.
controles.livre: E Jocsã gerou a Seba, e a Dedã: e filhos de Dedã foram Assurim, e Letusim, e Leummim.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֣י מִדְיָ֗ן עֵיפָ֤ה וָעֵ֨פֶר֙ וַחֲנֹ֔ךְ וַאֲבִידָ֖ע וְאֶלְדָּעָ֑ה כָּל־אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י קְטוּרָֽה׃

controles.web: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Hanoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.
controles.livre: E filhos de Midiã: Efá, e Efer, e Enoque, e Abida, e Elda. Todos estes foram filhos de Quetura.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתֵּ֧ן אַבְרָהָ֛ם אֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־ל֖וֹ לְיִצְחָֽק׃

controles.web: Abraham gave all that he had to Isaac,
controles.kjv: And Abraham gave all that he had unto Isaac.
controles.livre: Mas Abraão deu tudo quanto tinha a Isaque.

versos.hebraico: וְלִבְנֵ֤י הַפִּֽילַגְשִׁים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְאַבְרָהָ֔ם נָתַ֥ן אַבְרָהָ֖ם מַתָּנֹ֑ת וַֽיְשַׁלְּחֵ֞ם מֵעַ֨ל יִצְחָ֤ק בְּנוֹ֙ בְּעוֹדֶ֣נּוּ חַ֔י קֵ֖דְמָה אֶל־אֶ֥רֶץ קֶֽדֶם׃

controles.web: but to the sons of Abraham’s concubines, Abraham gave gifts. He sent them away from Isaac his son, while he yet lived, eastward, to the east country.
controles.kjv: But unto the sons of the concubines, which Abraham had, Abraham gave gifts, and sent them away from Isaac his son, while he yet lived, eastward, unto the east country.
controles.livre: E aos filhos de suas concubinas deu Abraão presentes, e enviou-os para longe de Isaque seu filho, enquanto ele vivia, até o oriente, à terra oriental.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֗לֶּה יְמֵ֛י שְׁנֵֽי־חַיֵּ֥י אַבְרָהָ֖ם אֲשֶׁר־חָ֑י מְאַ֥ת שָׁנָ֛ה וְשִׁבְעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וְחָמֵ֥שׁ שָׁנִֽים׃

controles.web: These are the days of the years of Abraham’s life which he lived: one hundred seventy-five years.
controles.kjv: And these are the days of the years of Abraham’s life which he lived, an hundred threescore and fifteen years.
controles.livre: E estes foram os dias de vida que viveu Abraão: cento e setenta e cinco anos.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּגְוַ֨ע וַיָּ֧מָת אַבְרָהָ֛ם בְּשֵׂיבָ֥ה טוֹבָ֖ה זָקֵ֣ן וְשָׂבֵ֑עַ וַיֵּאָ֖סֶף אֶל־עַמָּֽיו׃

controles.web: Abraham gave up the spirit, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full of years, and was gathered to his people.
controles.kjv: Then Abraham gave up the ghost, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full of years; and was gathered to his people.
controles.livre: E expirou, e morreu Abraão em boa velhice, ancião e cheio de dias e foi unido a seu povo.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקְבְּר֨וּ אֹת֜וֹ יִצְחָ֤ק וְיִשְׁמָעֵאל֙ בָּנָ֔יו אֶל־מְעָרַ֖ת הַמַּכְפֵּלָ֑ה אֶל־שְׂדֵ֞ה עֶפְרֹ֤ן בֶּן־צֹ֨חַר֙ הַֽחִתִּ֔י אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־פְּנֵ֥י מַמְרֵֽא׃

controles.web: Isaac and Ishmael, his sons, buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron, the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is before Mamre,
controles.kjv: And his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is before Mamre;
controles.livre: E sepultaram-no Isaque e Ismael seus filhos na caverna de Macpela, na propriedade de Efrom, filho de Zoar Heteu, que está em frente de Manre;

versos.hebraico: הַשָּׂדֶ֛ה אֲשֶׁר־קָנָ֥ה אַבְרָהָ֖ם מֵאֵ֣ת בְּנֵי־חֵ֑ת שָׁ֛מָּה קֻבַּ֥ר אַבְרָהָ֖ם וְשָׂרָ֥ה אִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: the field which Abraham purchased of the children of Heth. Abraham was buried there with Sarah, his wife.
controles.kjv: The field which Abraham purchased of the sons of Heth: there was Abraham buried, and Sarah his wife.
controles.livre: Herança que comprou Abraão dos filhos de Hete; ali foi Abraão sepultado, e Sara sua mulher.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֗י אַחֲרֵי֙ מ֣וֹת אַבְרָהָ֔ם וַיְבָ֥רֶךְ אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת־יִצְחָ֣ק בְּנ֑וֹ וַיֵּ֣שֶׁב יִצְחָ֔ק עִם־בְּאֵ֥ר לַחַ֖י רֹאִֽי׃ס

controles.web: After the death of Abraham, God blessed Isaac, his son. Isaac lived by Beer Lahai Roi.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass after the death of Abraham, that God blessed his son Isaac; and Isaac dwelt by the well Lahai–roi.
controles.livre: E sucedeu, depois de morto Abraão, que Deus abençoou a Isaque seu filho: e habitou Isaque junto a Beer-Laai-Roi.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֛לֶּה תֹּלְדֹ֥ת יִשְׁמָעֵ֖אל בֶּן־אַבְרָהָ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָלְדָ֜ה הָגָ֧ר הַמִּצְרִ֛ית שִׁפְחַ֥ת שָׂרָ֖ה לְאַבְרָהָֽם׃

controles.web: Now this is the history of the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s handmaid, bore to Abraham.
controles.kjv: Now these are the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s handmaid, bare unto Abraham:
controles.livre: E estas são as gerações de Ismael, filho de Abraão, que lhe deu à luz Agar egípcia, serva de Sara:

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֗לֶּה שְׁמוֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׁמָעֵ֔אל בִּשְׁמֹתָ֖ם לְתוֹלְדֹתָ֑ם בְּכֹ֤ר יִשְׁמָעֵאל֙ נְבָיֹ֔ת וְקֵדָ֥ר וְאַדְבְּאֵ֖ל וּמִבְשָֽׂם׃

controles.web: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to the order of their birth: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
controles.kjv: And these are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebajoth; and Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,
controles.livre: Estes, pois, são os nomes dos filhos de Ismael, por seus nomes, por suas linhagens: O primogênito de Ismael, Nebaiote; logo Quedar, e Adbeel, e Mibsão,

versos.hebraico: וּמִשְׁמָ֥ע וְדוּמָ֖ה וּמַשָּֽׂא׃

controles.web: Mishma, Dumah, Massa,
controles.kjv: And Mishma, and Dumah, and Massa,
controles.livre: E Misma, e Dumá, e Massá,

versos.hebraico: חֲדַ֣ד וְתֵימָ֔א יְט֥וּר נָפִ֖ישׁ וָקֵֽדְמָה׃

controles.web: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.
controles.kjv: Hadar, and Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah:
controles.livre: Hadade, e Tema, e Jetur, e Nafis, e Quedemá.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֣לֶּה הֵ֞ם בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׁמָעֵאל֙ וְאֵ֣לֶּה שְׁמֹתָ֔ם בְּחַצְרֵיהֶ֖ם וּבְטִֽירֹתָ֑ם שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂ֥ר נְשִׂיאִ֖ם לְאֻמֹּתָֽם׃

controles.web: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their villages, and by their encampments: twelve princes, according to their nations.
controles.kjv: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their towns, and by their castles; twelve princes according to their nations.
controles.livre: Estes são os filhos de Ismael, e estes seus nomes por suas vilas e por seus acampamentos; doze príncipes por suas famílias.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֗לֶּה שְׁנֵי֙ חַיֵּ֣י יִשְׁמָעֵ֔אל מְאַ֥ת שָׁנָ֛ה וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וְשֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֑ים וַיִּגְוַ֣ע וַיָּ֔מָת וַיֵּאָ֖סֶף אֶל־עַמָּֽיו׃

controles.web: These are the years of the life of Ishmael: one hundred thirty-seven years. He gave up the spirit and died, and was gathered to his people.
controles.kjv: And these are the years of the life of Ishmael, an hundred and thirty and seven years: and he gave up the ghost and died; and was gathered unto his people.
controles.livre: E estes foram os anos da vida de Ismael, cento e trinta e sete anos: e expirou Ismael, e morreu; e foi unido a seu povo.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשְׁכְּנ֨וּ מֵֽחֲוִילָ֜ה עַד־שׁ֗וּר אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־פְּנֵ֣י מִצְרַ֔יִם בֹּאֲכָ֖ה אַשּׁ֑וּרָה עַל־פְּנֵ֥י כָל־אֶחָ֖יו נָפָֽל׃פ

controles.web: They lived from Havilah to Shur that is before Egypt, as you go toward Assyria. He lived opposite all his relatives.
controles.kjv: And they dwelt from Havilah unto Shur, that is before Egypt, as thou goest toward Assyria: and he died in the presence of all his brethren.
controles.livre: E habitaram desde Havilá até Sur, que está em frente do Egito vindo a Assíria; e morreu em presença de todos os seus irmãos.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֛לֶּה תּוֹלְדֹ֥ת יִצְחָ֖ק בֶּן־אַבְרָהָ֑ם אַבְרָהָ֖ם הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־יִצְחָֽק׃

controles.web: This is the history of the generations of Isaac, Abraham’s son. Abraham became the father of Isaac.
controles.kjv: And these are the generations of Isaac, Abraham’s son: Abraham begat Isaac:
controles.livre: E estas são as gerações de Isaque, filho de Abraão. Abraão gerou a Isaque:

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֤י יִצְחָק֙ בֶּן־אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה בְּקַחְתּ֣וֹ אֶת־רִבְקָ֗ה בַּת־בְּתוּאֵל֙ הָֽאֲרַמִּ֔י מִפַּדַּ֖ן אֲרָ֑ם אֲח֛וֹת לָבָ֥ן הָאֲרַמִּ֖י ל֥וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃

controles.web: Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Paddan Aram, the sister of Laban the Syrian, to be his wife.
controles.kjv: And Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah to wife, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Padan–aram, the sister to Laban the Syrian.
controles.livre: E era Isaque de quarenta anos quando tomou por mulher a Rebeca, filha de Betuel arameu de Padã-Arã, irmã de Labão arameu.

versos.hebraico: וַיֶּעְתַּ֨ר יִצְחָ֤ק לַֽיהוָה֙ לְנֹ֣כַח אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ כִּ֥י עֲקָרָ֖ה הִ֑וא וַיֵּעָ֤תֶר לוֹ֙ יְהוָ֔ה וַתַּ֖הַר רִבְקָ֥ה אִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Isaac entreated Yahweh for his wife, because she was barren. Yahweh was entreated by him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.
controles.kjv: And Isaac intreated the Lord for his wife, because she was barren: and the Lord was intreated of him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.
controles.livre: E orou Isaque ao SENHOR por sua mulher, que era estéril; e aceitou-o o SENHOR, e concebeu Rebeca sua mulher.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתְרֹֽצֲצ֤וּ הַבָּנִים֙ בְּקִרְבָּ֔הּ וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אִם־כֵּ֔ן לָ֥מָּה זֶּ֖ה אָנֹ֑כִי וַתֵּ֖לֶךְ לִדְרֹ֥שׁ אֶת־יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: The children struggled together within her. She said, “If it be so, why do I live?” She went to inquire of Yahweh.
controles.kjv: And the children struggled together within her; and she said, If it be so, why am I thus? And she went to enquire of the Lord.
controles.livre: E os filhos se combatiam dentro dela; e disse: Se é assim para que vivo eu? E foi consultar ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה לָ֗הּ שְׁנֵ֤י גיים בְּבִטְנֵ֔ךְ וּשְׁנֵ֣י לְאֻמִּ֔ים מִמֵּעַ֖יִךְ יִפָּרֵ֑דוּ וּלְאֹם֙ מִלְאֹ֣ם יֶֽאֱמָ֔ץ וְרַ֖ב יַעֲבֹ֥ד צָעִֽיר׃

controles.web: Yahweh said to her,  “Two nations are in your womb. Two peoples will be separated from your body. The one people will be stronger than the other people. The elder will serve the younger.”
controles.kjv: And the Lord said unto her, Two nations are in thy womb, and two manner of people shall be separated from thy bowels; and the one people shall be stronger than the other people; and the elder shall serve the younger.
controles.livre: E respondeu-lhe o SENHOR: Duas nações há em teu ventre, E dois povos serão divididos desde tuas entranhas: E um povo será mais forte que o outro povo, e o maior servirá ao menor.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּמְלְא֥וּ יָמֶ֖יהָ לָלֶ֑דֶת וְהִנֵּ֥ה תוֹמִ֖ם בְּבִטְנָֽהּ׃

controles.web: When her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.
controles.kjv: And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.
controles.livre: E quando se cumpriram seus dias para dar à luz, eis que havia gêmeos em seu ventre.

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּצֵ֤א הָרִאשׁוֹן֙ אַדְמוֹנִ֔י כֻּלּ֖וֹ כְּאַדֶּ֣רֶת שֵׂעָ֑ר וַיִּקְרְא֥וּ שְׁמ֖וֹ עֵשָֽׂו׃

controles.web: The first came out red all over, like a hairy garment. They named him Esau.
controles.kjv: And the first came out red, all over like an hairy garment; and they called his name Esau.
controles.livre: E saiu o primeiro ruivo, e todo ele peludo como uma veste; e chamaram seu nome Esaú.

versos.hebraico: וְאַֽחֲרֵי־כֵ֞ן יָצָ֣א אָחִ֗יו וְיָד֤וֹ אֹחֶ֨זֶת֙ בַּעֲקֵ֣ב עֵשָׂ֔ו וַיִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְיִצְחָ֛ק בֶּן־שִׁשִּׁ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה בְּלֶ֥דֶת אֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: After that, his brother came out, and his hand had hold on Esau’s heel. He was named Jacob. Isaac was sixty years old when she bore them.
controles.kjv: And after that came his brother out, and his hand took hold on Esau’s heel; and his name was called Jacob: and Isaac was threescore years old when she bare them.
controles.livre: E depois saiu seu irmão, pegando com sua mão o calcanhar de Esaú: e foi chamado seu nome Jacó. E era Isaque de idade de sessenta anos quando ela os deu à luz.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיִּגְדְּלוּ֙ הַנְּעָרִ֔ים וַיְהִ֣י עֵשָׂ֗ו אִ֛ישׁ יֹדֵ֥עַ צַ֖יִד אִ֣ישׁ שָׂדֶ֑ה וְיַעֲקֹב֙ אִ֣ישׁ תָּ֔ם יֹשֵׁ֖ב אֹהָלִֽים׃

controles.web: The boys grew. Esau was a skillful hunter, a man of the field. Jacob was a quiet man, living in tents.
controles.kjv: And the boys grew: and Esau was a cunning hunter, a man of the field; and Jacob was a plain man, dwelling in tents.
controles.livre: E cresceram os meninos, e Esaú foi hábil na caça, homem do campo: Jacó porém era homem quieto, que habitava em tendas.

versos.hebraico: וַיֶּאֱהַ֥ב יִצְחָ֛ק אֶת־עֵשָׂ֖ו כִּי־צַ֣יִד בְּפִ֑יו וְרִבְקָ֖ה אֹהֶ֥בֶת אֶֽת־יַעֲקֹֽב׃

controles.web: Now Isaac loved Esau, because he ate his venison. Rebekah loved Jacob.
controles.kjv: And Isaac loved Esau, because he did eat of his venison: but Rebekah loved Jacob.
controles.livre: E amou Isaque a Esaú, porque comia de sua caça; mas Rebeca amava a Jacó.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֥זֶד יַעֲקֹ֖ב נָזִ֑יד וַיָּבֹ֥א עֵשָׂ֛ו מִן־הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה וְה֥וּא עָיֵֽף׃

controles.web: Jacob boiled stew. Esau came in from the field, and he was famished.
controles.kjv: And Jacob sod pottage: and Esau came from the field, and he was faint:
controles.livre: E cozinhou Jacó um guisado; e voltando Esaú do campo cansado,

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר עֵשָׂ֜ו אֶֽל־יַעֲקֹ֗ב הַלְעִיטֵ֤נִי נָא֙ מִן־הָאָדֹ֤ם הָאָדֹם֙ הַזֶּ֔ה כִּ֥י עָיֵ֖ף אָנֹ֑כִי עַל־כֵּ֥ן קָרָֽא־שְׁמ֖וֹ אֱדֽוֹם׃

controles.web: Esau said to Jacob, “Please feed me with that same red stew, for I am famished.” Therefore his name was called Edom.
controles.kjv: And Esau said to Jacob, Feed me, I pray thee, with that same red pottage; for I am faint: therefore was his name called Edom.
controles.livre: Disse a Jacó: Rogo-te que me dês a comer disso vermelho, pois estou muito cansado. Portanto foi chamado seu nome Edom.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר יַעֲקֹ֑ב מִכְרָ֥ה כַיּ֛וֹם אֶת־בְּכֹֽרָתְךָ֖ לִֽי׃

controles.web: Jacob said, “First, sell me your birthright.”
controles.kjv: And Jacob said, Sell me this day thy birthright.
controles.livre: E Jacó respondeu: Vende-me neste dia tua primogenitura.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר עֵשָׂ֔ו הִנֵּ֛ה אָנֹכִ֥י הוֹלֵ֖ךְ לָמ֑וּת וְלָמָּה־זֶּ֥ה לִ֖י בְּכֹרָֽה׃

controles.web: Esau said, “Behold, I am about to die. What good is the birthright to me?”
controles.kjv: And Esau said, Behold, I am at the point to die: and what profit shall this birthright do to me?
controles.livre: Então disse Esaú: Eis que vou morrer; para que, pois, me servirá a primogenitura?

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יַעֲקֹ֗ב הִשָּׁ֤בְעָה לִּי֙ כַּיּ֔וֹם וַיִּשָּׁבַ֖ע ל֑וֹ וַיִּמְכֹּ֥ר אֶת־בְּכֹרָת֖וֹ לְיַעֲקֹֽב׃

controles.web: Jacob said, “Swear to me first.”   He swore to him. He sold his birthright to Jacob.
controles.kjv: And Jacob said, Swear to me this day; and he sware unto him: and he sold his birthright unto Jacob.
controles.livre: E disse Jacó: Jura-me hoje. E ele lhe jurou, e vendeu a Jacó sua primogenitura.

versos.hebraico: וְיַעֲקֹ֞ב נָתַ֣ן לְעֵשָׂ֗ו לֶ֚חֶם וּנְזִ֣יד עֲדָשִׁ֔ים וַיֹּ֣אכַל וַיֵּ֔שְׁתְּ וַיָּ֖קָם וַיֵּלַ֑ךְ וַיִּ֥בֶז עֵשָׂ֖ו אֶת־הַבְּכֹרָֽה׃ס

controles.web: Jacob gave Esau bread and stew of lentils. He ate and drank, rose up, and went his way. So Esau despised his birthright.
controles.kjv: Then Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentiles; and he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way: thus Esau despised his birthright.
controles.livre: Então Jacó deu a Esaú pão e do guisado das lentilhas; e ele comeu e bebeu, e levantou-se, e foi-se. Assim menosprezou Esaú a primogenitura.
